title: Analysis of the Relationship Between NF-kappaB1 and Cytokine Gene Expression in Hematological Malignancy: Leveraging Explained Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Small Dataset Insights.
authors: Jeong, Jae-Seung; Ju, Hyunsu; Cho, Chi-Hyun
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习分析血液恶性肿瘤中NF-kappaB1与细胞因子基因表达关系，但仅基于基因表达统计，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: This study measures expression of nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB)1 and related cytokine genes in bone marrow mononuclear cells in patients with hematological malignancies, analyzing the relationship between them with an integrated framework of statistical analyses, machine learning (ML), and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI). While traditional dimensionality reduction techniques-such as principal component analysis, linear discriminant analysis, and t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding-showed limited differentiation embedding, ML classifiers (k-Nearest Neighbors, Naive Bayes Classifier, Random Forest, and XGBoost) successfully identified critical patterns. Notably, normalized caspase-1 counts consistently emerged as the most influential feature associated with NF-kappaB1 activity across disease groups, as highlighted by SHapley Additive exPlanations analyses. Systematic evaluation of ML performance on small datasets revealed that a minimum sample size of 15-24 is necessary for reliable classification outcomes, particularly in cohorts of acute myeloid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndrome. These findings underscore the pivotal role of caspase-1 to the NF-kappaB1 gene expression in hematologic malignancy diseases. Furthermore, this study demonstrates the feasibility of leveraging ML and XAI to derive meaningful insights from limited data, offering a robust strategy for biomarker discovery and precision medicine in rare hematological malignancies.
abstract_zh: 本研究检测了血液系统恶性肿瘤患者骨髓单个核细胞中核因子κB（NF-kappaB）1及相关细胞因子基因的表达水平，并通过统计分析、机器学习（ML）和可解释人工智能（XAI）的整合框架分析它们之间的关系。虽然传统降维技术——如主成分分析、线性判别分析和t分布随机邻域嵌入——显示出有限的区分性嵌入，但ML分类器（k近邻、朴素贝叶斯分类器、随机森林和XGBoost）成功识别了关键模式。值得注意的是，标准化caspase-1计数在不同疾病组中始终作为与NF-kappaB1活性相关的最具影响力特征出现，这一点由SHapley Additive exPlanations分析所强调。对ML在小数据集上性能的系统评估表明，最小样本量为15-24是实现可靠分类结果的必要条件，尤其是在急性髓系白血病和骨髓增生异常综合征队列中。这些发现强调了caspase-1在血液系统恶性肿瘤疾病中对NF-kappaB1基因表达的关键作用。此外，本研究展示了利用ML和XAI从有限数据中获取有意义见解的可行性，为罕见血液系统恶性肿瘤的生物标志物发现和精准医学提供了稳健策略。
